user.title: Voice Bridge
user.description: Send Assist transcripts to tmux-voice-bridge, which types them into a tmux pane (or hands them to a waiting agent-media `converse`).

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the bridge. Is tmux-voice-bridge running, and is the URL reachable from Home Assistant?
error.bad_reply: The bridge answered, but not with the expected chat-completions shape.

abort.already_configured: That bridge URL is already set up.
